# Stepping stones (D-217): the run codes

The eight greedy runs the stepping stones were looked at with in the dev build, develop against `phase/stepping-stones`: each is the run one play before its end, at a build screen, for the screenshots in `stepping-stones-1.png` and `stepping-stones-2.png`. Made in Node with the rules at `fbbdcf1`, content `af553691` (the codes name their build `stones`). All eight replay in full on develop after D-219 too (content `cc8bff1c`), with notices that the code is from another build and the content has changed since. Open a link, then look at the front yard below the front door.

- **`walk-13`**: straight down from the door to the kerb, where the household walks in (stepping-stones-1.png, top). Front door in the south wall at cell (20, 16). [Open on /dev/](https://swalliso.github.io/house-game/dev/?run=OH1.)
- **`walk-35`**: across two Lawns, then round the Doghouse to the kerb (stepping-stones-1.png, bottom). Front door in the south wall at cell (10, 16). [Open on /dev/](https://swalliso.github.io/house-game/dev/?run=OH1.)
- **`walk-18`**: round a Patio’s table and the trees (stepping-stones-2.png, top). Front door in the south wall at cell (16, 12). [Open on /dev/](https://swalliso.github.io/house-game/dev/?run=OH1.)
- **`walk-37`**: a deep front yard, round the Doghouse (stepping-stones-2.png, bottom). Front door in the south wall at cell (6, 7). [Open on /dev/](https://swalliso.github.io/house-game/dev/?run=OH1.)
- **`walk-23`**: a deep, dry front yard, straight down to the kerb. Front door in the south wall at cell (15, 11). [Open on /dev/](https://swalliso.github.io/house-game/dev/?run=OH1.)
- **`walk-20`**: a front door in an east wall, down to a fence. Front door in the east wall at cell (8, 5). [Open on /dev/](https://swalliso.github.io/house-game/dev/?run=OH1.)
- **`walk-0`**: none: a Fence a step below the door. Front door in the south wall at cell (12, 21). [Open on /dev/](https://swalliso.github.io/house-game/dev/?run=OH1.)
- **`walk-29`**: none: the door boxed in by Trees. Front door in the south wall at cell (9, 16). [Open on /dev/](https://swalliso.github.io/house-game/dev/?run=OH1.)
